release_notes: Durable Conversions API delivery and browser matching context (PR #16, thanks @lucasvaz013). An incoming postback now stores the conversion, click counters, the FX audit and the Meta/TikTok queue events in one short SQLite transaction with lock retries: a failed queue write rolls the unit back and answers 500/503 instead of acknowledging an event that was never queued, and repeated postbacks reuse the original intent instead of duplicating it. Meta matching context is preserved end to end: complete fbclid/fbc/fbp values (no 512-byte truncation), a fresh ad click overrides a stale _fbc cookie, cookies created after the first request are captured through a signed click-scoped endpoint, and an anonymous visitor identity is hashed once for Meta. event_source_url is now truthful: the configured page, a JSON map keyed by the Meta event name, the new {offer_url} macro or an explicit event_source_url in the postback — the acquisition referrer is no longer substituted for the producer's checkout, so configure the real event page when upgrading. The queue worker now requires Meta to confirm the full batch (events_received) and stops retrying permanent API errors; the PHP KClient forwards the visitor's real IP/User-Agent (fixing the lost ua parameter); the pixel event URL hint mentions the new macros. Migration 52 is additive (queue index + signing-key table); no history is replayed.
